title: Inspect an annotation-checking wrapper
description: You can follow explicit argument checks around three functions with different annotations.

steps.description: checked reads type hints and builds a wrapper. Each supplied positional argument is checked unless its expected type is Any.
After calling the function, the wrapper also checks an annotated return type. It then returns the result.
add annotates both parameters as int. sloppy uses Any, while half_typed annotates x alone.

steps.question: Which parameter does the wrapper reject in add('a', 3)?
steps.answer: It rejects x because its value is str and its annotation is int.

steps.description: The recording shows the wrapper's diagnostic for add and successful string concatenation for sloppy. It also records a separate Python arithmetic error from sloppy's body.
The half_typed calls return 3 for integer inputs and reject a string x. The proposed strict-mode extension remains outside this supplied implementation.
